# harness_autostopping_rule_vm (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving a Harness AutoStopping rule for VMs.

## Example Usage

### Lookup by ID

```terraform
data "harness_autostopping_rule_vm" "by_id" {
  identifier = "12345"
}
```

### Lookup by name (regex)

```terraform
data "harness_autostopping_rule_vm" "by_name" {
  name = "^my-vm-rule$"
}
```

### Lookup by name pattern

```terraform
data "harness_autostopping_rule_vm" "by_pattern" {
  name = "my-vm-.*-prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identifier` (String) Unique identifier of the resource. Either `identifier` or `name` must be specified.
- `name` (String) Name or regex pattern to match the rule name. Either `identifier` or `name` must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_connector_id` (String) Id of the cloud connector
- `depends` (List of Object) Dependent rules (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--depends))
- `dry_run` (Boolean) Boolean that indicates whether the AutoStopping rule is in DryRun mode
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `idle_time_mins` (Number) Idle time in minutes. This is the time that the AutoStopping rule waits before stopping the idle instances.

### Nested Schema for `depends`

Read-Only:
